set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
test "$(sha256sum /usr/bin/input_keyevent | cut -d " " -f1)" = 7284ad5b0117a96a166a4fe327c6361bea998e5d2086a0e1a36d2a3477a87db9
cat /proc/uptime
set +e
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Right down
key_down_status=$?
sleep 0.15
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Right up
key_up_status=$?
printf 'KEY_DOWN_EXIT=%s KEY_UP_EXIT=%s\n' "$key_down_status" "$key_up_status"

cat /proc/uptime
{ /usr/bin/vlogutil -v kerneltime -t 3 2>&1; source_exit=$?; printf '\nVLOG_SOURCE_EXIT=%s\n' "$source_exit"; } | grep -Ei 'csfs|keyrouter|Right|input|focus|VLOG_SOURCE_EXIT' | tail -c 42000
vconftool get memory/eden/current_tab
cat /proc/uptime
